name: Sour Muffin and The Pumpkin Princess
source:
Sour Muffin and the cupcake crew were busy having fun trick or treating when they heard someone in distress.

It turned out it was a lost, little witch trying to get back to her people before midnight. Willow is about to become Queen of the Pumpkin People and the cupcake crew agreed to assist...

Of course, Halloween became a bit more than they expected, but it was another grand adventure supporting friendship, empathy, teamwork and multiculturalism.

[From [url=https://williamclarke.itch.io/sour-muffin-and-the-pumpkin-princess]itch.io[/url]]
